<div id="open-positions" class="positions-header">
  <h2>Open Positions at GHYAN Laboratory</h2>
  <p>
    We welcome enthusiastic and self-motivated researchers to join our lab in the Department of Physics at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.
  </p>
</div>

<div class="positions-grid">

  <!-- 1. Postdoctoral Positions -->
  <div class="position-card">
    <div class="position-top">
      <div>
        <h3 class="position-title">1. Postdoctoral Positions</h3>
        <span style="display: block; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500; color: #7a7771; margin-top: 0.2rem;">(IPDF / NPDF / Fellowships)</span>
      </div>
      <span class="position-badge active">Open</span>
    </div>

    <p class="position-desc">
      We invite motivated postdoctoral candidates with background in experimental condensed matter physics, spintronics, magnetism, or computational micromagnetics/multiphysics.
    </p>

    <ul class="position-details">
      <li><strong>Fellowships:</strong> Open to candidates holding or applying for ANRF/SERB N-PDF, Institute Postdoctoral Fellowship (IPDF), CSIR, UGC, or other national fellowships.</li>
      <li><strong>Form a Project:</strong> Prospective fellows are encouraged to contact the PI to jointly formulate and develop a competitive research project proposal.</li>
    </ul>

    <div class="position-footer">
      <a href="mailto:rahulgupta@iitism.ac.in?subject=Postdoctoral%20Position%20Proposal%20-%20GHYAN%20Lab" class="position-apply-link">
        Contact PI to Form a Project &rarr;
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 2. PhD Positions -->
  <div class="position-card">
    <div class="position-top">
      <div>
        <h3 class="position-title">2. PhD Positions</h3>
        <span style="display: block; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500; color: #7a7771; margin-top: 0.2rem;">(Institute Funded &amp; JRF)</span>
      </div>
      <span class="position-badge active">Open</span>
    </div>

    <p class="position-desc">
      We welcome applications from prospective PhD candidates interested in exploring spin, orbital, and hybrid quantum phenomena in thin films and heterostructures.
    </p>

    <ul class="position-details">
      <li><strong>Funding Schemes:</strong> Positions are available through <strong>IIT (ISM) Institute Fellowships</strong> and external fellowships (<strong>CSIR-UGC JRF</strong>, DST-INSPIRE, or valid GATE/NET qualification).</li>
      <li><strong>Application:</strong> Prospective candidates should email Dr. Rahul Gupta and formally apply via the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad PhD Admission Portal.</li>
    </ul>

    <div class="position-footer">
      <a href="mailto:rahulgupta@iitism.ac.in?subject=PhD%20Application%20-%20GHYAN%20Lab" class="position-apply-link">
        Email PI &rarr;
      </a>
      <a href="https://admissions.iitism.ac.in/phd/index.php/admission/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #7a7771; text-decoration: none;">
        Admission Portal ↗
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 3. Master's Thesis Projects -->
  <div class="position-card">
    <div class="position-top">
      <div>
        <h3 class="position-title">3. Master's Thesis Projects</h3>
        <span style="display: block; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500; color: #7a7771; margin-top: 0.2rem;">(M.Sc. / M.Tech. Students)</span>
      </div>
      <span class="position-badge active">Open</span>
    </div>

    <p class="position-desc">
      Opportunities are available for enthusiastic Master's students seeking semester projects or dissertation research in thin-film spintronics and numerical simulations.
    </p>

    <ul class="position-details">
      <li><strong>Eligibility:</strong> M.Sc. in Physics / Applied Physics or M.Tech. in Materials Science, Nanotechnology, or related disciplines.</li>
      <li><strong>Scope:</strong> Hands-on experience with thin-film deposition, magnetotransport, FMR, or micromagnetic modeling (COMSOL, MuMax3).</li>
    </ul>

    <div class="position-footer">
      <a href="mailto:rahulgupta@iitism.ac.in?subject=Master%20Thesis%20Project%20Inquiry%20-%20GHYAN%20Lab" class="position-apply-link">
        Contact PI with CV &rarr;
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 4. Bachelor's Thesis & Internship Projects -->
  <div class="position-card">
    <div class="position-top">
      <div>
        <h3 class="position-title">4. Bachelor's Thesis &amp; Internships</h3>
        <span style="display: block; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500; color: #7a7771; margin-top: 0.2rem;">(B.Tech / B.Sc. Projects)</span>
      </div>
      <span class="position-badge active">Open</span>
    </div>

    <p class="position-desc">
      Positions are open for motivated undergraduate students interested in semester-long thesis projects, capstone research, or summer/winter internships.
    </p>

    <ul class="position-details">
      <li><strong>Duration:</strong> Typically 2–6 months (summer/winter internships or semester thesis projects).</li>
      <li><strong>Application:</strong> Interested undergraduate students must submit their application through our dedicated Google Form.</li>
    </ul>
